fusions.name: Rib-Wing Stoop
fusions.desc: A gliding strike at a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 12 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach, and knocks it back 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Moult Scatter
fusions.desc: Costs 4% of your maximum health. Sheds quill-edged scales in a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 8 damage with a 40% chance of [Bleeding] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Branch to Branch
fusions.desc: Glides you instantly to a spot up to 6 tiles away, and you have 10% more dodge chance.

fusions.name: Rising Warmth
fusions.desc: Covering ground restores 5 stamina to you. Once every 4 seconds.
